Additionally, a signal will be sent to the security key indicating that individual attestation may be used. Without this, users will be prompted in Chrome 65+ when sites request attestation of security keys. URLs (like "https://example.com/some/path") will only match as U2F AppIDs. Domains (like "example.com") only match as WebAuthn RP IDs. Thus, to cover both U2F and WebAuthn APIs for a given site, both the AppID URL and domain would need to be listed.
